The temporary runner checked reference instead of the helper’s controlDoc property. Original repeat-export evidence remains valid; six supplemental both-backend repeated/reference pairs verify all three independent controls.

These fixtures do not declare treated semantic reveals; graph, camera, exposure and export code remain unchanged.
